lines.text: BABYMONNSTERRR! That hydraulic press just stamped 'DEPRECATED' on the Mona Lisa!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: It's trying to round her smile into an approved corporate emoji!

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Hack the press, Ashwath! I'm drawing vector barricades over the art!
